book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yohanus kule pisne taŋgo pasa kuklina
Ait ta mbolŋge Yohanus kule pisne taŋgo nu promba Yudea ma baknu mbolŋge pasa kuklimba teŋenmba saka minna:
Kuate nu nuŋe gageu kulatkam tuku ait buk patukate. Tane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba maŋau ŋaigonu kusrekap ŋgina.
Tuan taŋgo Aisaia nu ande tuku sakina ta nu Yohanus tuku sakina. Nu teŋenmba kuyarna.

content.text: Ma baknu mbolŋge wi ande kueŋka teŋenmba sakate. Suŋgo tuku ndin wakeimba kuanekap. Nu likam tuku ndin te-tiwap ŋgate. Aisaia 40.3

content: Yohanus nu kamel ŋguenu ŋak tawi silika let tiŋgina. Nu tuku nyamagaŋ ta kasbur wak le ŋguimzaŋ kulenu. Nu agaŋ ta nyumba minanu.
Yudea tumbraŋ yimyam Yerusalem tumbraŋ suŋgo Yordan kule patukŋge tumbraŋ mine likinaig ta ŋakmba Yohanus tugum prowe likinaig. Nane naŋgine une maŋau kile-mayokke likinaig le
nu ndek Yordan kule mbolŋge nane kule pisneniŋmba minna.

Farisi mbal Sadusi mbal nane gudommba kule pisneniŋguwa ŋga nu tugum pronaig le nu nane saniŋgina: Tane mbeŋ tuku fat Kuate tuku pa tam tuku minig. Tane imaŋge riroŋ pasa satiŋgat le pa ta laiptiŋguwa ŋga kule pisne tam prode.
Tane siŋka ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba taŋgine maŋau ŋaigonu kusrekinaig ndeta alonu kumumbi kile-mayokkap le kaŋgerkube.
Tane Abraham nu sine tuku mbuŋ ŋga payam ndakap. Ye tane kilimok satiŋget. Kuate nu tane pitaika ndame kame tembi Abraham tuku ndare kitek kile-mayokkam kumuŋ.
Kuate nu sapor ail tugunu tugumŋge pilna le minit. Ail afu alo mage ndade ta ŋakmba pike lika pankate le pa mbol kinig.

Tane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba maŋau ŋaigonu kusrekade ta ye tane kulembi kule pisnetiŋget. Ande ye ŋgumnemŋge prowamŋgat ta nu ye tuku saŋgri lite. Ye taŋgo mayenu kuga. Ye nu tugumŋge nu tuku kupe ŋgaro kugrakam wam ŋai ta mata nu mbolŋge kam kumuŋ kuga. Nu Tukul Guwambi pambi tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal kule pisne taŋaŋ tiŋgamŋgat.

Nu wit pileŋgam bafute. Nu pro wit mbain mbolŋge minig ta silimba bareŋmba alonu kilmba nuŋe nyamagaŋ wande mbolŋge patikamŋgat. Nu tiglu kilmba pa mbolŋge kutuwa le ugmba minmba minamŋgat. Pa ta kupe nda ŋga nane saniŋgina.
Yesus nu Galilea ma kusremba kumba ka Yohanusŋge nu kule pisnewa ŋga Yordan kule mbol ta prona sulumba
Yohanus sana le nu ndek peuwam bafumba sakina: Ye taŋgo mayenu kuga. Yeŋge ne kule pisnenam kumuŋ kuga. Neŋge ye kule pisneya ta maye ŋgina.
Taŋakina le nu lafumba sana: Ne mbule ndaka. Kuateŋge maŋau dubikam tuku tumsiŋgit ta sine kusrekam kumuŋ kuga ŋgina. Taŋakina le Yohanus nu woka Yesus kule pisnena.
Nu kule silika bitekŋgina le samba talkina le Kuate tuku Guwa gami taŋaŋ ndeka nu mbolŋge minyokina le Yohanus nu kaŋgerna.
Taŋamba samba mbolŋge pasa ande teŋenmba mayok kina: Ande te yiŋe Kiŋo. Ye nu tuku kume purmba nu tuku gare suŋgo tet ŋgina.

footnotes.text: O buk tuan taŋgo Elia nu mata kamel ŋguenu ŋak tawi silika let tiŋganu. Zu mbal nane Elia nu amboŋga prowamŋgat ŋga idusmba minnaig ta kuyar pasa ta Yohanus tuku sakina ta nane katese ndanaig.
